obfuscation_indicators: duration and impact on customer demand
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantitative and transparent regarding fiscal 2019 performance, liquidity, debt, and nonrecurring gains. Risk tone is moderately negative because comparable sales and earnings declined and COVID-19 caused store closures, significant operational disruption, and withdrawal of guidance. COVID-19 duration and financial impact remain unquantified, creating elevated forecasting uncertainty.
